title: 第270章 杨起家向你发起了跑刀挑战，航天刷天圆地方了？
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我操，牛逼！”

这朴实无华的三个字从杨起家嘴里蹦出来的时候，他自己都觉得干的慌。

不是，他刚才可是全程在那喊“快跑快跑”来着。

甚至还把人家指到了一条没卡的死路上去，

本以为这把就这样没了，他的三千万素材局也要就此消失。

但谁曾想对方直接一手一打三，总共才用了二十四多发子弹就成功灭队了。

这特么.....

杨起家搓了搓脸，似乎想要把刚才自己做出指挥的那一幕遗忘。

本想开口想办法给自己刚才的行为做出一点解释，实在不行就认一回唐，总之就是快速过渡掉这个话题来着。

但还没等他开口，他的直播间就已经先一步闹腾起来了。

【杨哥，刚才你让我蜂医哥跑路的话，我已经截图准备做成表情包了。】

【“蜂医哥你先跑，你就是个绿裤子你打不过的！“——杨起家，2025。】

【哈，最搞笑的是你杨哥指挥半天指向了一个死路！他没卡！】

【笑死，我说GTI的人就没有弱的有没有人懂？真别以为人家是绿裤子就不强吧？那威龙不也有当区的一面？】

【就是，你杨哥的热度在三角洲也不低吧，主玩的也是威龙，怎么没人看到威龙就觉得是区？】

杨起家看着弹幕，一张脸涨得通红，手指在键盘上来回移动了好几次，最终还是忍不住爆发了。

“行了行了！你们这些串子能不能有点新鲜的？“

“我承认刚才那波指挥是我失误了行吧？但你们能不能想，我那是被一枪爆头之后的应急反应？谁他妈被人从背后一狙打死还能保持冷静思考的？“

“你行你上啊！你被人偷了之后你能第一时间记得你上一把用没用卡？“

【能。】

【我能。】

【我也能。】×999

“...“

杨起家深吸一口气，双手搓脸又搓了足五秒钟，好不容易平复了一下情绪后继续说道。

“而且我说白了，刚才那波我是被偷的好吧！是被三个人从牢区阴出来偷的！“

“你们当时都看见了吧？我在修脚之前可是一直保持警惕的，从宿舍静步过来全程没有暴露！是最后吃包的时候没注意牢区还有一队！“

“这种事情换做谁来都一样，搁你在那吃九个包你能一边吃一边三百六十度无死角扫描吗？你以为你是雷达啊？“

【可是杨哥，人家蜂医本来的位置也和你差不多，但人家在吃之前还不是知道把包搬一下？】

【是啊，而且人家后面被你指错路，走到死胡同呢，不一样能反杀？】

【你俩的区别就是——你是贪吃上了脑，而人家只是正常饿了吃饭。】

【结论：我杨哥是区，不接受反驳。】

“你们特么——！“

杨起家指着屏幕的手在空中僵了一秒，最终又放了下来。

不是他说不过，是他确实没法反驳。

因为弹幕说的有好一部分是事实，因为他确实没想过这个点了牢区还能有人。

而且后续人家蜂医的表现也确实很亮眼。

这也难免会让他们得出——蜂医猛而你杨哥菜的结论了。

“行吧，枪法不如人我认了。“杨起家咂了咂嘴，语气里带着一股不服输的劲儿，“但你们也别觉得我就什么都不行了好吧？“

“我跟你们说，三角洲这游戏讲究的可不只是枪法！“

“搜打撤搜打撤，搜索才是占大头的！能搜能跑能活着出去，那才是真本事！“

说到这里，杨起家的眼睛忽然亮了起来。

他想到了一个东西。

没错，刚才蜂医那波操作确实猛，M14压枪确实神，但——那完全就是靠纯粹的枪法硬实力在碾压。

换句话说，蜂医之所以打赢不是因为他有什么高超的战术思路，而是因为他枪太准了。

你看他之前跑路的时候是什么表现？

虽然是他指挥失误在前，但他在路过的时候也应该看一下包里有没有卡呀？

咳咳，虽然这个说法确实有些牵强，属于是你杨哥的嘴硬时间。

但其实正常来讲的话，你在入局之前也该看一下自己的卡包是不是有着那些必需通道卡的吧？

所以你杨哥说这蜂医没思路纯枪硬是不是有道理的？

但跑刀可不一样。

跑刀讲究的是信息判断、路线规划、风险评估，还有最重要的——对整个地图资源分布和人员走向的预判。

这些东西可真不是枪法能解决的吧？

“蜂医哥！“杨起家忽然开口了，声音里终于重新带有了些许活力。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Holy shit, awesome!"

When these three simple words came out of Yang Qijia's mouth, he felt so panicked.

No, he was just shouting "Run, run, run" the whole time.

He even pointed people to an unblocked dead end road.

I thought this one would be gone, and his 30 million material bureau would disappear.

But who would have thought that the opponent would directly hit three with one hand, and it only took a total of more than 24 rounds of bullets to successfully wipe out the team.

What the hell...

Yang Qijia rubbed his face, as if he wanted to forget the scene where he gave the command just now.

I wanted to open my mouth and think of a way to explain my behavior just now, but if it didn't work, I would admit it to Tang. In short, I would quickly transition away from the topic.

But before he could say anything, his live broadcast room had already started to make a fuss.

[Brother Yang, if you asked my bee doctor brother to run away just now, I have already taken screenshots and prepared them to be made into emoticons.】

["Brother Bee Doctor, run away first, you are just a green pants and you can't beat me!" - Yang Qijia, 2025.】

[Ha, the funniest thing is that your brother Yang pointed to a dead end for a long time!He's not stuck!】

[Laughing, I said that GTI people are not weak, does anyone understand?Don’t really think that someone with green pants is not strong, right?Doesn't Veyron also have a local side?】

[That’s right, your brother Yang’s popularity is not low in Delta, right? The main player is Veyron. Why doesn’t anyone think it’s a district when they see Veyron?】

Yang Qijia looked at the barrage, his face flushed red, his fingers moved back and forth on the keyboard several times, and finally he couldn't help but explode.

"Okay, okay! Can you guys have some fresh skewers?"

"I admit that I made a mistake in the command just now, okay? But can you think that it was my emergency response after being shot in the head? Who the hell can still think calmly after being shot to death from behind?"

"You can do it! Go ahead! After you were stolen, can you immediately remember whether you used the last card or not?"

【Yes.】

【I can.】

【I can do it too.】×999

"..."

Yang Qijia took a deep breath, rubbed his face with both hands for five seconds, and finally calmed down before continuing.

"And let me tell you the truth, I was stolen in that incident just now! It was three people who came out from the cell area and stole it!"

"Did you all see it at that time? I had been vigilant before getting the pedicure. I walked quietly from the dormitory without being exposed the whole time! I didn't notice that there was a team in the cell area when I was eating the bag at the end!"

"This kind of thing is the same for everyone. If you were to eat nine bags, could you scan them 360 degrees without blind spots while eating? Do you think you are a radar?"

[But Brother Yang, my bee doctor’s original position is similar to yours, but don’t you know how to move your bag before eating?】

[Yes, and if someone in the back is pointed in the wrong direction by you and reaches a dead end, why not kill him?】

[The difference between you two is that you are greedy, while the other person is just eating when he is hungry.】

[Conclusion: I, Brother Yang, am from the district and do not accept refutation.】

“What the hell are you—!”

Yang Qijia's hand pointing at the screen froze in the air for a second, and finally put it down again.

It's not that he can't say it, it's that he really can't refute it.

Because a lot of what the barrage said was true, because he really never thought that there would be people in the cell area after clicking this button.

And the subsequent performance of the bee doctor was indeed very impressive.

This will inevitably lead them to the conclusion that bee doctors are fierce and you, Yang Ge, are poor.

"Okay, I admit that my marksmanship is not as good as that of others." Yang Qijia smacked his lips, with a tone of unwillingness to admit defeat, "But don't think that I can't do anything, okay?"

"Let me tell you, the game Delta is about more than just marksmanship!"

"Search, strike, and retreat. Search and strike, strike and retreat. Search is the most important! Being able to search, run, and get out alive is your real skill!"

Speaking of this, Yang Qijia's eyes suddenly lit up.

He thought of something.

Yes, Bee Doctor's operation just now was really fierce, and the M14 gun was really amazing, but - it was completely crushed by the sheer force of marksmanship.

In other words, the bee doctor won not because he had any superb tactical ideas, but because his gun was so accurate.

Did you see how he behaved when he ran away before?

Although it was his command that made the mistake first, he should have checked if there was any card in his bag when passing by?

Ahem, although this statement is indeed a bit far-fetched, it is your time for Brother Yang to be tough.

But in fact, normally speaking, you should check whether your card pack contains the necessary channel cards before entering the game, right?

So, does it make sense for you, Brother Yang, to say that this bee doctor has no ideas and is just a stickler?

But running a knife is different.

Running knife focuses on information judgment, route planning, risk assessment, and most importantly - prediction of the distribution of resources on the entire map and the direction of people.

These things really can't be solved with marksmanship, right?

"Brother Bee Doctor!" Yang Qijia suddenly spoke, his voice finally regaining some vitality.
